title: Verify evals on Papers with Code
body:
Hi,

Niels here from the open-source team at Hugging Face. Congratulations on your work!

I've made the [paper](https://paperswithcode.co/paper/2610.14726) and [1 paper-native evaluation](https://paperswithcode.co/paper/2610.14726#results) available on Papers with Code.

The paper is part of the [Video generation](https://paperswithcode.co/tasks/video-generation) task page.

The LightVAE-Lite (MiniMax-H3) result currently ranks first on [VBench-2.0](https://paperswithcode.co/benchmark/vbench-2-0?task=video-generation&eval=38620).

Would it be possible to verify these results and let me know if any score, model name, benchmark protocol, or openness metadata should be corrected?

You can also edit the task, methods, project page, and GitHub URL directly from the paper page using your Hugging Face account.

If you'd like to showcase the results in your repository README, you can copy these live leaderboard badges (or use the “Copy PwC badge” button in the Results section):

[![Papers with Code: SOTA on VBench-2.0](https://paperswithcode.co/api/v1/papers/2610.14726/leaderboard-badge.svg?eval=38620&live=1)](https://paperswithcode.co/api/v1/papers/2610.14726/leaderboard-badge-link?eval=38620)

Kind regards,

Niels
